texts.value: Structural protein involved in the filamentous cross-bridging between microtubules and other skeletal elements

3 different light chains, LC1 (a cleavage product of MAP1B), LC2 (a cleavage product of MAP1A) and LC3 (produced by one of the MAP1LC3 genes), can associate with the MAP1A or MAP1B heavy chains. Interacts with TIAM2. Interacts with guanylate kinase-like domain of DLG1, DLG2 and DLG4. Binds to CSNK1D (By similarity)
The basic region containing the repeats may be responsible for the binding of MAP1A to microtubules
LC2 is generated from MAP1A by proteolytic processing
